label: copy phase, mid-sequence: input and output both from {3,2,o,p,t,z} class
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phases), mostly at recall_idx 3-4 of longer sequences (L>=6; absolute t 10-13), and not on the final output step. The fed-back input token is almost always from {3,2,o,p,t,z,k,g} (3 and 2 strongest; essentially zero on other letters) and the token being output is from the overlapping set {o,p,z,3,t,2} (also g,k,r,j,f more weakly). The strongest activations come when two of these tokens are adjacent in the copy, e.g. input 3 while outputting o (d u 3 o p ...). Precision is low (about 0.3-0.4): many steps that meet the token conditions stay silent, and I could not find the extra history condition that decides it (preceding-token and prev2 conditions did not help). Rate goes up with more digits among the originals.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 3, 2, o, p, t, z; least: y, 0, l, s) and the token being output (most: o, p, z, 3, t, 2; least: -, y, v, d); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, t=12.
